      (∑ i ∈ Finset.range k, (i + 1) * Nat.factorial (i + 1)) + (k + 1) * Nat.factorial (k + 1) := by exact?

/-- Helper: factorial growth ensures subtraction is valid -/

lemma fact_ge_one (n : ℕ) :
